title: Bonsai Typed Fact v1
description: Canonical typed-fact ABI (BN-024-02). Serialized form of bonsai::typed_facts::TypedFact. This schema describes data only; it confers no graph-write authority. Rust TypedFact::validate() is authoritative for invariants the schema cannot express (payload fields/state XOR, digest recomputation, grant-to-fact binding, lifecycle timestamps).

schema_version.description: Must equal the writer's SCHEMA_VERSION; newer versions are rejected pending explicit upgrade.

fact_id.description: SHA-256 over the canonical identity tuple (entity key + observation key + interpretation identity + semantic payload digest + evidence digest) assigned by TypedFact::seal() and re-verified by validate().

scope.description: Canonical tenant/environment identity scope; absent = default scope.

network_namespace.description: ASIC/network namespace (SONiC asic-0/host, FRR default, ...); independent of namespace.

entity.description: Entity identity within the namespace (interface name, prefix, neighbor address, ...).

plane.description: Truth plane: operational | configured | effective | startup | ...

exporter_id.description: Protocol-level exporter claim (BMP exporter, gNMI target, host key ref). Evidence only — never canonical device identity.

parser_revision.description: Parser implementation revision identifying the exact extraction logic (template version, code version or content digest).

mapping_revision.description: Normalization ruleset version applied after parsing; absent = no mapping layer recorded.

fields.description: Structured fact body (JSON object). Absent iff state is present; the fields/state XOR is enforced by Rust validate(), not by this schema.

state.description: Required when fields is absent; forbidden when fields is present. 'capture_failed' = source capture failure; 'no_usable_records' = decoded input existed but no usable validated entity fact; 'output_budget_exhausted' = the effective output-fact budget prevented every entity fact. These degraded states are distinct from 'empty' (capture succeeded with a genuinely empty decoded population) and 'invalid_input' (input rejected before parsing). Must stay in sync with PayloadState in src/typed_facts.rs; drift is gated by tests/test_bn024_typed_facts.py against v1.states.fixture.json.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical semantic payload (fields XOR state plus interpretation identity). Recomputed by validate(); post-seal mutation is detected.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical evidence reference list — binds the fact to its supporting observation content digests.

trust.description: Authority eligibility CLAIM, separate from parse quality. A serialized claim is evidence only — it never satisfies authority eligibility by itself.

authority.description: Authority grant evidence bound to this exact fact's subject/source axes. Grants are minted in-process from a trusted IdentityResolution; deserialized grants are unattested (attested flag is never serialized) and confer no eligibility. Rust validate() rejects grants whose bound axes do not match the fact.

lifecycle_changed_at.description: Required for withdrawn/superseded; forbidden for active; optional for stale.
